serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Britannia: So anyway, how did you get to know my father? 
You: I’m his tenant.
Britannia: That’s gotta be, like, so unlucky~ Are you ok? Did he force you to do all this?
You: Not really. I pitied him a little.
Britannia: Damn, man. That was a big mistake. That bastard doesn’t deserve pity. 
You: You really seem to hate him. Is there any specific reason? 
Britannia: Specific? If I had to pick one I would say that I’m just the team mom.
You: Ah, I see. 
As we were walking, Britannia stopped next to a cafe. 
You: What? Do you want to go in? 
Britannia: Not really. Someone I knew used to go there frequently. 
You: A friend?
Britannia: Of course not! Stuuupid!
You: Ok, ok. Let’s get moving.
You: You said you are rich and famous. How did you manage that? 
Britannia: I’m a fashion designer, you see. I worked hard to get where I am. Of course my dad’s money helped too.
Britannia: I dropped out of college to chase a dream and I succeeded. Not many people can say the same. 
You: Alright, we are here.
